titulo: What Does HSPF2 on a Heat Pump Mean? #shorts
descripcion: HSPF2 = BTU of heat per watt-hour of electricity over a heating season. 1 Wh = 3.412 BTU, so HSPF2 ÷ 3.412 = units of heat per unit of electricity. Federal minimum HSPF2 7.5 (10 CFR 430.32) → about 2.2, or 45% of the electricity of a baseboard heater. HSPF2 9 → about 2.64 (38%). Typical cold-climate home in Minnesota: $1,065 vs $888 a year (EIA RECS 2020 heating needs, EIA MN electricity 16.44¢/kWh, Jan–Aug 2026). Running costs only.
